Missions

Loving in deed, and in truth

Three programmes, two kinds of fieldwork and four forms of help, to meet today’s needs and help everyone stand on their own tomorrow.

Three programmes

01

Support for people in need

Food, clothing, financial and spiritual support for people going through hard times.

02

Training workshops

Workshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns, so everyone can become self-reliant: budgeting, employment, family life, faith.

03

Helping other associations

Supporting other associations that carry social and humanitarian projects, here and abroad [countries to confirm].

Four areas of help

Food

Grocery baskets, hot meals on outreach, supermarket food drives.

Clothing

Coats, boots and warm socks for the Québec winter.

Education

School supplies, homework help, support for students.

Material or financial

A discreet helping hand when life suddenly tips over.

In the field

Food drives

At supermarket entrances, we invite shoppers to share a few groceries, which are then passed on to the families we support.

Street outreach

In the streets of several Canadian cities, for people who are homeless, orphanages and students: a hot meal, clothing, and time to listen.

Need help?

If you or someone close to you is going through a hard time, write to us in confidence. We answer every message.

Write to us

A Christian association serving orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless — Montréal, since 2014.
